svg.title: Undo and redo
svg.desc: Every edit is an UndoableAction with do and undo closures; patterns used to make them.
svg.text: Undo (newui::UndoStack of {description, doIt, undoIt})
UndoStack
Move
Draw Rectangle
Fill Color
Make Symbol
push(action): runs doIt() at once, clears redo
Patterns used for the closures
snapshot before / after
geometry drags: commitGeometry(before, ...) takes the outlines as they are now as `after`;
undo puts `before` back (GeometryState + FrameState). Style edits: StyleState (appearance items).
apply(state) lambda
most edits build apply(states) and push {do: apply(after), undo: apply(before)}
(text changes, flags, layer snapshots, brush swaps, artboards).
slots for objects
add / delete / replace share objects through std::shared_ptr<Slot>: do attaches,
undo detaches (detach() records the stacking index so redo puts it back where it was).
library changes
symbols_ / patterns_ / brushes_ are replaced wholesale by before / after vectors.
(Known gap: undoing Make Symbol removes the instance, not the definition.)
Rules that keep it sound
- Object ids are stable for the life of the document (nextId_), so closures refer to ids, never pointers; findById() on every apply.
- Selection and the active layer/artboard are views of the document: not undo steps. Edits that remove objects fix the selection (dropUnselectable).
- Live editing (drags, scrubbing, previews) changes objects WITHOUT pushing; the one step is pushed when the gesture ends (or nothing, if cancelled with Esc).
- A load or New clears the stack. batch edits inside a Batch announce changes once (documentFromSvg / documentFromBinary).
- Each edit ends in changed(): syncLayers(), markModified(), updateAllViews(), onChanged -> panels refresh.
